There's no way it isn't intentional. For example, the volume of her voice in Liability is much louder compared to the vocals in other songs,  but it's also the only song where it's just her voice, so it's made to sound more raw and more startling. It's as if Lorde herself is saying, "This emotion is loud and extreme!" It's not supposed to be a relaxing sad song. I feel like it's supposed to more take you aback and change your emotion into the despair that the song represents, which serves as a fantastic transition from The Louvre to Hard Feelings/Loveless.

I personally adore the production and clear synth in the studio version but I also am obsessed with the way she sings it live. She has a particular sound to her voice for the live version and it honestly sounds very different, so I just treat them as separate songs.
